name: browser-use
headline: Zotero Search Skill - Search Zotero Libraries
short_description: Search and analyze Zotero research collections using Pyzotero. Ideal for operations teams managing large libraries. Connects to Zotero and Semantic Scholar for enhanced research capabilities.
author: urschrei

sections.overview:
The Zotero Claude Skill enables users to search and analyze their Zotero research libraries directly through Claude. It leverages Pyzotero to access library data, run targeted searches, and examine results. The skill also integrates with Semantic Scholar to retrieve related literature and expand research discovery. This is particularly useful for researchers, academics, and operations teams managing large research collections who need programmatic access to their Zotero databases.
Search Zotero libraries for specific papers or topics
Analyze research collection contents and metadata
Discover related literature through Semantic Scholar integration
Manage and organize large research databases programmatically
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/urschrei/zotero_search_skill`
sections.usage:
```
Search my Zotero library for articles related to [TOPIC] in [INDUSTRY]. Provide a summary of the top 5 most relevant articles, including their titles, authors, publication dates, and key findings. Also, suggest 2-3 additional research directions based on the results.
```
Copy

```
# Zotero Search Results for 'AI in Healthcare'
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
